questions.q: What should each row of a field mapping document capture?
options: Only the source column name
Only the Salesforce field's API name
The source column, the target Salesforce field, and the transformation rule
The password for the source database
questions.explain: Each row defines where a value comes from, where it goes, and how it is transformed on the way.

questions.q: Which of these is a typical type-mismatch problem when loading a CSV into Salesforce?
options: A currency symbol or comma in a value destined for a number field
A CSV file with a .csv extension
A header row with column names
A field name in uppercase
questions.explain: Number fields expect clean numeric values, so symbols and separators cause failures. Dates and text length are other common trouble spots.

questions.q: Why do you need a translation (crosswalk) table for picklist values?
options: Salesforce picklists cannot hold text
Picklists are always converted to numbers automatically
Data Loader translates all values without any input
The source system's codes often differ from the Salesforce picklist values, and unlisted values can be rejected by a restricted picklist
questions.explain: A crosswalk maps each source value to a valid Salesforce value, including a decision for blanks and unexpected values.

questions.q: How are multiple values entered for a multi-select picklist in a load file?
options: In separate rows with the same Id
In a single cell, separated by semicolons
Separated by pipe characters in different files
Multi-select picklists cannot be loaded
questions.explain: Multi-select picklist values are supplied in one cell separated by semicolons, for example Red;Blue;Green.

questions.q: What does a STRING_TOO_LONG error in the error file mean?
options: The CSV file has too many rows
The Salesforce Id is 18 characters long
A value in the row is longer than the target field allows
The org's data storage is full
questions.explain: STRING_TOO_LONG means a text value exceeded the field's maximum length, so either shorten it or change the mapping.
